note: Finale C, the Spire Jump (verdance.campaign.acts; game_verdance_jump_gate.lua). The Spire Gate (va_jump_gate, Armada's Experimental Gantry body) stands unfinished on zoneId (the company's rock above the drop, dry ground with room for the fusions; the hive holds the central spillways); finished, it charges while the company generates needPower energy a second within radius (any finished generator; until 2026-11-03 it wanted four advanced fusions, which no T1 constructor builds, and the company raises T2 labs only on All That Simmers); charged, a named hero holding on its pad for channelSeconds goes through. Each step enrages the raptors (rage*/anger*); the last hero through wakes the queen.
